candidate.blueprint_topic: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control — infection-prevention quality monitoring
candidate.educational_objective: Recognize monitoring plus feedback as a core infection-prevention performance-improvement practice.

options.A: Regularly monitor adherence to recommended infection-prevention practices and provide feedback to staff to improve performance.
options.B: Measure infection-prevention adherence only after a major outbreak.
options.C: Avoid giving staff feedback because performance data should remain confidential from the care team.
options.D: Replace observation and monitoring with annual policy review alone.

candidate.rationale: CDC Core Infection Prevention and Control Practices include monitoring adherence to recommended practices and providing feedback to health-care personnel to improve performance.
candidate.source_claim_supported: CDC recommends monitoring adherence to infection-prevention practices and providing feedback to improve performance.
candidate.source_document_title: Core Infection Prevention and Control Practices for Safe Healthcare Delivery in All Settings
candidate.source_organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
candidate.stem: Which infection-prevention activity best reflects CDC guidance on performance monitoring and feedback?
